#A Unique, Airboat Ride Through Several Ecosystems!

## Rates
**Person:** $45
*Price online is a pre payment* ($14.99)

## Duration
1 Hours

## About
Airboats offer a unique experience, like no other. Whether you are coming alone or are accompanied by your family members, the airboat ride will not disappoint you. The joy of riding an airboat hits high speeds is something that you cannot always express in words. And then, sailing across the **River of Grass**, you’ll be amazed to see the tropical island filled with lush vegetation. The captains make sure you see the most unbelievable sights that you have perhaps never seen before. Remember to keep your eyes and ears wide open while you sail as you never know when you’ll come across an alligator or other rare species


## About The Airboat
Young or old, everybody favors an airboat ride to the Everglades. And why not, an airboat is perhaps the best transportation choice that takes you to this **eco-wonderland** and helps you explore its riches. There’s nothing like getting the sweet fragrance of this marshland when you take a ride through its dense mangroves. Included is a show by the Indian Natives of Florida. Learn and see their culture, foods, hunting techniques and much more. Truly an awesome way to see and enjoy a whole new world. Don’t miss out on this unique experience that you can only capture on this tour. Wonderful learning and exciting experience for all ages alike.

##What to Bring

- Comfortable clothing & shoes
- License or valid ID

## Meeting location
305 Lincoln Road Miami Beach
